paragraphs.text: Zaxara , the Exemplary is a legendary nightmare hydra from the plane of Ikoria .

Lurking among the peat bogs of Indatha, this many-headed nightmare hydra oozes toxins from every pore. Zaxara's vivid coloration serves as a warning to any creature that might want to take a bite out of it. Only other hydras seem immune to its toxins, sometimes coating themselves in puddles of Zaxara’s leftover poison to make themselves even more dangerous.
